description: Stable identifier: country, document type, year and number.
ISO country code.
Empty for national rules. A sub-national code (country code plus state) for state-level law, such as Sabah or Sarawak in Malaysia.

Legal form of the document. Plans such as RUPTL and PDP8 are their own type; emergency regulation (Perppu), advisory, code, regulator determination and directive cover instruments that are not numbered regulations.
Number as printed on the document.
Short label used in lists and charts.

example: Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources (ESDM)
description: Body that signed the document.
Sector the issuer sits in, so cross-sector policies (mining, trade, fiscal) can be told apart.
How the rule reaches the energy sector. One or more values.
Date signed. YYYY or YYYY-MM is allowed until checked.
Date the rule takes effect; can differ from the signing date.

example: Peraturan Menteri ESDM Nomor 2 Tahun 2024 tentang …
description: Title in the language of the binding text.

example: MEMR Regulation 2/2024 on Grid-Connected Rooftop Solar
description: English title (our own translation).

example: Ends credit for exported rooftop power …
description: Two or three sentences on what it does and what changed. Drafted, then checked by a reviewer.
Topic ids from the fixed topic list. Each topic belongs to one category (electricity, energy and climate, supply chain and industrial policy, trade); a rule's categories follow from its topics.
Technologies the instrument specifically concerns: solar-pv, wind, batteries, electric-vehicles, grid-equipment or hydrogen. Empty when it is not technology-specific.
Ids of earlier rules this one partly amends.
Ids of earlier rules this one fully revokes or replaces.
Later rules that amend this one. Worked out from the amends links; never typed.
Later rules that revoke this one. Worked out from the revokes links; never typed.
Ids of rules this one implements (a decree or circular that carries out a law, decision or resolution).
Ids of rules this one overrides in part without amending or revoking them, such as a higher-ranking rule that sets new prices.
Later rules that implement this one. Worked out from the implements links; never typed.
Later rules that override this one in part. Worked out from the overrides links; never typed.
Basis for this rule's amends/revokes links: express clause (the text says so), implied by successor (e.g. a new plan replacing the old one) or expired.
Empty means legally binding. 'no' for policy documents without legal force, such as party resolutions or roadmaps.

description: For rules that have ended but still apply to existing contracts or projects: a short note on who keeps the old terms.
Current status: in force, amended (in force with changes), pending (adopted, not yet in force), draft (proposed, not adopted), replaced, revoked or expired.
Date the status was last checked.
Link to the official source.
document (the text itself) or portal-search (a placeholder until review).
Language of the binding text.
verified, partly verified or unverified.
Who reviewed the row.
When it was reviewed.
Open questions and caveats for reviewers and readers.
